payload.description_html: Freshwater crocodile (also called Johnson) in Australia. This population grows to a maximum length of 3 meters and has a conspicuously narrow and pointed snout. Not classified as dangerous to humans, the freshwater crocodile is native to the northern coasts of Australia. Seen in Geikie George National Park.
